cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: the paved square before a city gate tower — carries her keepsake low at her side; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a quiet library reading room with tall bookshelves — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a Peking opera dressing room — standing at a work surface; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her; a domed marble hammam with warm stone slabs and brass bowls — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; a sunny bay behind a speedboat — swimming breaststroke; a domed observation cupola of an orbital station of her world — floating weightless in mid-air with nothing beneath her; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — lying on her front; the Changban Bridge memorial — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a sunny concrete skate park of smooth bowls and ramps — standing balanced on her board
